description: Cost comparison of SGLI (0.06 USD per 1,000 USD of coverage per month plus a 1 USD monthly fee) against a private term premium over the given number of years: monthly and total SGLI cost, total private cost, and which is cheaper. The page's age field is not used by its calculation and is not a parameter here. Use when the user compares SGLI coverage cost with a private life insurance quote. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive SGLI vs private insurance calculator.

private_monthly.description: Private term insurance monthly premium in USD.

years.description: Comparison horizon in years (minimum 1, as on the page).
